matched_queries: Employer responsibilities and worker rights: Planning staffing during strikes where minimum-service requirements or work-notice rules are explicitly explained.
Discover UK employment guidance for Minimum service levels: repeal. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
This non-statutory guidance accompanies the Strikes (Minimum Service Levels: Passenger Railway Services) Regulations 2023.

It is intended for use by employers and trade unions whose employees or members work to deliver minimum levels of services (MSL), specified in the regulations, during strikes. It sets out:

the background to the regulations

the scope of services covered by the regulations

a practical explanation of the MSL

This may be read in conjunction with:

reasonable steps to be taken by a trade union: code of practice

minimum service levels (MSL): issuing work notices
